messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: merging arg_refactor into develop
parts:
The arg_refactor branch is messing up other pull requests
which are being done relative to develop, and will then need
to be redone for consistency with arg_refactor. This includes
the RStan and PyStan interfaces, Marcus's work on optimization,
etc.

I'd like to get a stable (i.e., passing all unit tests) version
merged ASAP. It doesn't need to be complete --- we can continue
to make pull requests after the merge.

Is there anything broken that is stopping us from merging now?

- Bob

messages.author: 2a7f346506a3e9ff
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] merging arg_refactor into develop
parts:
Also, perhaps once we do this we could put out a call for users to try and beta test this and give us feedback on the new interface?  It could be targeted towards command line users, as I'm not sure how many UI type changes there are on the R side.

It would be nice to start converging towards a 2.0 release and this would be one good way to nudge ourselves in that direction.

Cheers,
Marcus
